CHAP. XXVIII. 
 
  Hananiah's false prophecy: Jeremiah's answer, ver. 1-9.   Hananiah breaks Jeremiah's yoke: he foretells an iron yoke,   and Hananiah's death, ver. 10-17. 
 
  V. 1. The fourth year-Perhaps the fourth year of the sabbatical course is here intended.  Of Gibeon-it is probable from the place where he lived, which was one of the cities of the priests; that he was a priest.
V. 13. But-Thou hast further incensed God against them, and provoked him to make their judgment heavier.
V. 17. Died-Within two months after Jeremiah had thus prophesied; so dangerous a thing it is for ministers to teach people contrary to the revealed will of God.
